findings.title: Admin list query and owner display are gated on the server-side session user, not on request input
findings.why: `user` is loaded in server.js:58 from the session token joined to `users`, so `user.is_admin` comes from the database, not from the request. The admin branch (server.js:264) runs the all-projects query and the regular branch (server.js:265) keeps the `owner_id = $1` condition. The owner span (server.js:266) is emitted only when `user.is_admin`, so regular users get no owner text. Owner and slug values pass through `esc` (server.js:16), which escapes `& < > " '`, so no HTML injection via usernames or slugs.

findings.title: Admin-only project list has no pagination
findings.why: the admin query has no LIMIT. Fine for seed sizes; a human may want pagination before real use. Not a requirement in the ticket.

findings.title: owner name on the admin's Projects list has no label, so it can read as a stray word
findings.why: The admin row renders `Onboarding alice` with no "Owner" or "by" text. A person scanning the list may read "alice" as part of the project name or as a tag. The owner text is present, but its meaning is not explicit. A label such as "by alice" or "Owner: alice" would make R2 read as done to a person. I could not view the admin list: the `VIEW: /projects --as bob-admin` run failed (browser driver timeout), so this rests on the code, not a screenshot.

findings.title: admin's own project row is not in any screenshot, so the owner label on that row is not seen
findings.why: Both admin screenshots were taken after `login --as bob-admin` with no `projects.create` step, so bob-admin owns nothing and the list shows only "Onboarding alice". The owner element for a row owned by the admin (the case where `owner` is `bob-admin`) is therefore not rendered in any screenshot. The code path is the same for every row, so I expect it to look the same, but the rendered row is unverified.

views.proof: toolkit login --as bob-admin ; toolkit open --path /projects ; toolkit screenshot --name admin-projects-list
